A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the chitinase catalyzed polymerization of sugar oxazolines was affected by the fluorine substituent on the C-6 position.
we succeeded in the polymerization of 6-fluorinated sugar oxazolines with chitinase as the catalyst, which was not possible with the non-substituted sugar oxazoline derivative.
the polymerizability of the sugar oxazoline derivative depends on the steric hindrance of the C6 substituent, and the polymerizability is not related to the C3 hydroxyl group.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the polymerizability of sugar oxazoline monomers can be enhanced by fluorine substituents.
the polymerizability of 6-deoxy- 6-fluoro- sugar oxazoline derivative is higher than that of the corresponding 6-deoxy-sugar oxazoline derivative.
the fluorine atom is a powerful tool for the control of chitinase-catalysis, which will be applicable for the design of new chitinase-cleavable linkers.
